title: My Requests
summary: Show every dismissal request a student has sent, with its day, date, time and reason.

steps.title: Add the header
steps.objective: Start the My Requests screen with a title bar.
steps.concept: A header sits at the top of a screen and tells people where they are.
steps.expected: A title bar appears at the top of the phone.

expect.label: A Header sits in the Header zone of My Requests
expect.fail: Drag the Header tool onto the glowing Header zone.

hints: Find the glowing Header tool in the toolbox on the left.
Drag it onto the glowing Header zone of the phone.
On a touch screen: tap Header, then tap the glowing Header zone.

steps.title: Name your screen
steps.objective: Give the screen a clear title.
steps.concept: The header will say “My Requests”. A clear title means nobody gets lost.

expect.label: The header says exactly: My Requests

hints: Click the header on the phone to select it.
Edit Text content in the Properties panel.

steps.title: Add the request list
steps.concept: The list is connected to the collection called dismissals. Each request shows the student, SID, grade, day, date, time and reason.
steps.expected: A list panel appears in the Body zone.

expect.label: A List sits in the Body zone of My Requests
expect.fail: Drag the List tool onto the glowing Body zone.

hints: Find the glowing List tool in the toolbox on the left.
Drag it onto the glowing Body zone of the phone.
On a touch screen: tap List, then tap the glowing Body zone.

steps.title: Write a hint
steps.objective: Add a line that explains the list.
steps.concept: A short sentence helps new students understand the screen.
steps.expected: Your hint appears on the screen.

cmds: ADD TEXT "Your requests are listed here."

expect.label: The message is exactly: Your requests are listed here.

hints: ADD TEXT adds a line of text.
Put the text inside straight quotation marks.
Copy the command from the step card exactly, then press Run Commands.

steps.title: Final style check: every colour, border, shadow and style
steps.objective: Give your screens the same colours, shapes and shadows as the model app.
steps.concept: Colours were chosen while you built each element. Now finish the whole look: every colour, background, border, corner, shadow and text style below must match the model app you tried at the start. Items you already set show a tick.
steps.expected: Your screens look exactly like the model app.
hints: Click the element on the phone first. The style box (Choose colours, borders and corners) opens by itself.
Follow the sub-steps one by one: each says which row to use and which option to click. The red dot shows where.
Text alignment and weight are in the Properties panel (right) under “Text and layout”.

steps.title: Run and check your requests
steps.concept: The list shows the requests saved in the previous module. Tap the box to tick one off.
steps.expected: Your requests are listed with their details.

expect.fail: Send a request in Module 3 first, then run this screen.

If it is empty, send a request in Module 3 first.

objectives: Show every dismissal request in a list.
See the day, date, time and reason of each request.
Choose colours that make the list easy to read.

mcqs.q: What is a list component used for?
a: Showing many saved items of the same kind
mcqs.why: A list repeats one layout for every saved record.

mcqs.q: What should a list show when nothing has been saved yet?
a: A friendly message that says what to do
An error that closes the app
mcqs.why: Empty states should guide the user rather than confuse them.

mcqs.q: Why does the list update by itself when a new request is saved?
a: It reads the stored data every time the screen is shown
mcqs.why: The screen shows whatever is in the collection right now.

mcqs.q: What is a collection in app data?
a: A named group of saved records of one kind
mcqs.why: Collections keep related records together, such as all requests.

mcqs.q: Why should each screen have one main job?
a: It is easier to use, build and test
mcqs.why: A focused screen is clear to users and simple to check.
